args.message: Hi Isla, your return for order O-0001836 is approved and we've refunded the full $27.98 to your original payment method. We've also reported the app logout problem on order history to our engineering team. Thanks for letting us know.

Hi Ben, your order O-0001019 shipped on 2025-10-03 with Swiftway Parcel (tracking 890415013460). It was marked "Out for delivery" on the morning of 2025-10-05, which is the promised delivery date, so it should reach you today. Thanks for your patience.

Hi Quinn, thanks for getting in touch. I found your order O-0001587 (total USD 80.97), delivered on 2025-04-28. Our return window is 30 days from delivery, and your request on 2025-06-17 falls on day 50, so I'm sorry, but we can't accept this return. Thank you for understanding.

Hi Olu, thanks for your patience. Order O-0001632 shipped on 2025-10-01 with Swiftway Parcel (express, tracking 603910194919). It was marked "Out for delivery" from the local depot late on 2025-10-02, and it's due by 2025-10-03. If it hasn't arrived by the end of today, reply here and we'll look into it further.

Hi Vera, thanks for getting in touch. I found your order O-0001173 (USD 744.95), which was delivered on 2025-01-24. Our returns window is 30 days from delivery, and your request on 2025-03-05 falls on day 40, so I'm sorry, but we can't accept this return or issue a refund. Thank you for understanding.
